channel.title: Rochdale Daily

item.title: Rochdale to face York City again after April title decider
item.description: Rochdale will meet York City in League Two, marking their first encounter since last season's thrilling title decider in the National League.

item.title: Measles: the symptoms to look out for in your child, and when to get help
item.description: More than 1,000 measles cases have been confirmed in England this year, 111 of them in the North West. Here is how the illness starts and the warning signs that need urgent care.

item.title: Rochdale IT provider offers solutions for email disruptions during Microsoft outages
item.description: Rochdale-based IT provider No Fuss IT has urged local businesses to consider alternative communication methods in light of recent Microsoft 365 outages that disrupted email services. The company, led by Finn O’Loughlin, highlighted the potential consequences of email disruptions, including unanswered customer inquiries and delayed purchase orders.

item.title: Rochdale’s own Stonehenge? What archaeologists actually know about the moorland stones
item.description: Surveys and excavations show Bronze Age cairns and widespread prehistoric flint scatters on the moors above Rochdale — but the idea of a local ‘Stonehenge’ is disputed and needs more professional study.

item.title: Christmas giving in Rochdale: the toy appeal, the foodbank and the mayor's charities
item.description: New, unwrapped toys for children aged up to 16 are needed by Friday 11 December, while Rochdale Foodbank is short of juice, rice, toothpaste and coffee.
